description: This file is an Android Java source class named DeviceScanActivity, responsible for scanning Bluetooth LE devices, displaying them in a list, and handling user interactions to select devices for further control.

classes.name: DeviceScanActivity
classes.description: Main activity for scanning Bluetooth LE devices, managing the device list, and initiating device connection activities.

classes.name: LeDeviceListAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for managing the list of Bluetooth devices found during scanning.

classes.name: ViewHolder
classes.description: Helper class for caching views within list items.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, checks for BLE support, and sets up Bluetooth adapter.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Ensures Bluetooth is enabled, initializes device list adapter, and starts device scanning.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Stops scanning and clears device list to conserve resources when activity is paused.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user click on a device, stopping scanning and launching DeviceControlActivity with selected device info.

methods.name: scanLeDevice
methods.description: Manages starting and stopping Bluetooth LE device scans with timeout.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates menu and updates visibility based on scanning state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu selections to start or stop scanning.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result of Bluetooth enable request; finishes activity if user declines.
